description: Audit a SAML message: paste it as raw XML, as the base64 of an HTTP-POST binding, or as the deflated+base64 SAMLRequest/SAMLResponse of a Redirect binding (a whole URL works). Finds a missing signature, weak signature or digest algorithms (SHA-1), duplicate IDs and a signature that references a different element than the one being read (signature wrapping), no NotOnOrAfter, expired, no AudienceRestriction, no InResponseTo, unencrypted assertions, a non-success status and secrets in attributes. Returns issuer, NameID and attributes too. It does NOT verify the signature cryptographically against a certificate.

input.description: The SAML message: XML, base64 (POST binding) or a Redirect URL / deflated value

name: saml_audit
